column7: Instructions: How to Use This Sheet
1. Click File -> Make a Copy to use the spreadsheet yourself
2. Customize all configurations on this page in the B column
3. On any page you want to use, select Do/Skip/Block for each task, making sure to Lock tasks you haven't unlocked yet
4. For each task you're doing, select Variant, extensions, bracelet usage, and slayer cape usage
5. If using "Like a Boss", select all task lengths in the E column on this page
6. Hover the mouse over any cell with this black triangle in the corner for extra notes or explanations
Contact me on discord at KodakKid3#1140 if you find any bugs or issues I can address

Notes about XP Rates:
- Kill/hr rates are estimates based upon my own limited testing and research
- They assume generally efficient stats, gear and solo methods without alts
- Your own rates will vary hugely based on stats, gear, supplies, methods, attention paid etc
- Higher numbers than mine are achieveable, but lower numbers are likely for most players
- I will fill in & improve XP rate data over time, but obscure tasks may take me a while
Customizing Your XP Rates:
- For personalized XP/GP rate calculations, you can input your own data into Mob Data
- Raw Kills/Hr is the primary variable you can change to adjust XP/GP rates
- Kills/trip and travel time are used for extra precision, but can be left blank
- You can add Costs/kill to make GP rate more accurate
Note on Errors:
- Div/0 error usually means the kills/hr data for a task variant in Mob Data is blank. To resolve this, you can fill a number yourself
- N/A usually means you've selected to "Do" a task, but haven't chosen a variant for it
